M3 — 2026-10-13
In a driven lane, env-prefixed commands (SOFAR_CONFORMANCE_RECORD=1 …, SOFAR_CORE=… …) and cargo clippy/fmt need approval. To record a conformance golden or run conformance through a core, temporarily hardcode RECORD / the CORE path in packages/engine/test/conformance/harness.ts, run `npx vitest run packages/engine/test/conformance/conformance.test.ts -t <case>`, then revert. The debug core from `cargo test` is target/debug/sofar-core.
